verdict.rationale: Pendo documents some first-party API surface: REST API calls for track events, an API endpoint for bulk-deleting accounts and visitors, and public developer APIs for mobile frameworks. Nothing shows that the API matches the UI, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: documentation of API coverage for guides, segments, analytics/reports, session replay and configuration; any statement of UI parity; a published API reference or spec; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use the API endpoint to delete accounts and visitors without contacting our support team.
Pendo provides public developer APIs for the following frameworks: Native Android, Native iOS, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin Forms, Xamarin Maui
